issues: 兄弟卡是灰色占位小卡，熄灭前后都没有信息，"世界"不成立
背景从浅灰直接变成平黑，光的变化没有来源
终帧孤卡很小、只有卡内小字，海报缺一句收束的话
主卡光晕是一圈均匀的白边，像描边而不是光
changes: look 换成 graphite（近单色暗场 + 白，金色只点一周）；世界改成 44 块深石墨小屏组成的控制室屏幕墙，正中 2×2 是主卡「99.999%」
后拉 2.4→0.62 / 118f 改 bezier(0.33,0,0.15,1)：起步柔、主体段快、长尾减速；按 2.4× CSS zoom 布局，开场特写字锐利（Q2）
熄灭按到主卡距离由近到远、起点 EASE.out 错峰（越往外越密，塌暗在加速）；每块先断电 6f 再沉入暗处 14f（opacity + 下沉 + 压暗）
环境光 = 仍亮着的屏幕占比，墙越灭四周越暗；最后收成落在主卡上的一束窄顶光 + 白色轮廓光与两层冷白光晕
落定后屏幕空间 56px 结语「Five nines. All year.」逐词虚化入场；时长 150→168f
issuesEn: Sibling cards were grey placeholders with no information before or after fading, so the 'world' never existed
The background jumped from light grey to flat black with no motivated light change
The final card was small with only tiny in-card text, and the poster lacked a closing line
The hero glow was an even white ring that read as an outline, not light
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark with white, gold on a single week); the world is a control-room wall of 44 dark graphite screens with the 99.999% hero card in the central 2×2 slot
Pull-back 2.4→0.62 over 118f on bezier(0.33,0,0.15,1): soft start, fast middle, long decelerating tail; laid out at 2.4× CSS zoom so the opening close-up is crisp (Q2)
Screens die nearest-first with EASE.out staggered starts (denser outward, an accelerating collapse); each loses its content in 6f, then sinks into the dark over 14f
Ambient light tracks the share of screens still lit, so the room darkens as the wall dies, ending in a narrow top light on the hero with a white rim and two cool halos
A 56px screen-space closing line 'Five nines. All year.' blurs in word by word; duration 150→168f
